imported_incompleteness_clause: Imported Session에는 clarification, human active time, approval, evidence invalidation, completion claim이 완전하지 않을 수 있으므로 공식 점수를 발급하지 않는다.

classes.source_clause: Verified Assessment: AOS controlled wrapper가 시작부터 종료까지 감싼 세션만 공식 AOS-Coding P0 발급 가능
classes.statement: Verified Assessment: only a session that records the AOS controlled wrapper wrapping it from start to end may be issued an official AOS-Coding P0. This contract checks that the record makes that claim completely and consistently; it does not establish that the run was observed.

classes.source_clause: Imported Session: 기존 Codex·Claude Code 기록의 사후 분석은 DIAGNOSTIC ONLY
classes.statement: Imported Session: post-hoc analysis of an existing Codex or Claude Code record is DIAGNOSTIC ONLY, as is every record that fails to make the complete controlled-session claim.

requirements.source_clause: Verified Assessment: AOS controlled wrapper가 시작부터 종료까지 감싼 세션만 공식 AOS-Coding P0 발급 가능
requirements.statement: The record claims one start-to-end wrapper bracket: one assessment.started and assessment.ended declaring the wrapper actor, one run, one correlation, a bracket that spans time, and no activity outside it.
requirements.predicate: exactly one assessment.started and assessment.ended declare the wrapper actor, share the session run id and one correlation id, span at least one millisecond, and contain every other event in time
requirements.failure_mode: a record whose activity begins before or continues after the bracket does not claim a start-to-end wrapping at all, so it cannot be Verified; a record that does make the claim is not thereby shown to be a capture rather than a reconstruction

requirements.source_clause: run 시작 시 capability snapshot과 adapter digest를 저장한다.
requirements.statement: A capability snapshot and adapter digest are recorded as stored at run start, strictly before any other recorded activity.
requirements.predicate: one adapter.capability_declared event declaring the wrapper actor strictly precedes every non-bracket event and the stored snapshot carries exactly the six capability digest fields
requirements.failure_mode: a snapshot taken at or after the first observed event describes an adapter that was already working, so it proves nothing about what was captured

requirements.statement: The session declares one runtime, model and harness identity whose components are unambiguous, and every event agrees with it.
requirements.predicate: the session declares a known runtime with a model and harness, no component containing the identity delimiter, and every event reports the identity id derived from that triple
requirements.failure_mode: an identity mismatch is an invalidating condition under SSOT 6.1 gate 10, and a component carrying the join character would make two different identities report one id

requirements.source_clause: adapter core events: REQUIRED event set 완전
requirements.statement: Every unconditionally REQUIRED SSOT 9.2 event group is observed and no action is left unattributed.
requirements.predicate: every one of the 7 unconditionally REQUIRED SSOT 9.2 event groups is observed and no event records an unknown actor attribution
requirements.failure_mode: a missing REQUIRED group or an unknown attribution withholds the score rather than degrading it silently
